facts.fact: 他确认 Arthur 还活着——在 Ravenscar 的记忆护理病房，那意味着痴呆
facts.anchor: Arthur Sanderson was alive, in Ravenscar, in memory care. That means dementia, he thought.

facts.fact: 他认定电塔就是一切：如果有答案，就在那里找，就像 Arthur 当年那样
facts.anchor: The pylon was everything. If there were answers, he would look for them there, just as Arthur had looked for them.

facts.fact: 雪里的电塔更狰狞——没有什么能软化它，黑压压不祥地立着，腿张开，螳螂手臂伸出来
facts.anchor: In the snow it looked even more monstrous than it had before. Nothing remained to soften it; it stood dark and ominous over the snow, legs spread, mantis-arms outstretched.

facts.fact: 他自语：一个怪物般的神——也许我们只配拥有这种神
facts.anchor: A monstrous god, he told himself; perhaps the only kind we deserve.

facts.fact: 他认出照片背面的潦草字句是 Dylan Thomas 诗的断句：他们的言辞没有引下闪电
facts.anchor: Their words had forked no lightning

facts.fact: Caroline 的声音从电线里低语：它睡着了，你现在为什么要唤醒它
facts.anchor: It’s asleep, whispered Caroline’s voice from the wires overhead. Why would you want to wake it now?

facts.fact: Benn 的声音接上：如果它让你失去理智呢
facts.anchor: And if it costs you your sanity? This time the voice was Dr Benn’s.

facts.fact: 他仰面倒在雪里，看见电塔可怕的对称性像上帝之眼般旋转
facts.anchor: seeing the awful symmetries of the pylon over him shift and turn like the Eye of God.

facts.fact: 他狂笑：雪里的天使！——全书唯一一次他笑了
facts.anchor: Angels in the snow, he thought, and started to laugh hysterically.

facts.fact: 电塔什么都没给：没有低语、没有怒火、没有启示、没有愤怒的闪电
facts.anchor: no whispering; no wrath; no revelation. No bolt of angry lightning.

facts.fact: 他走回家，路上只有他堆的雪人在等他
facts.anchor: nothing was waiting for him, except for the snowman he’d built on the path, waiting to welcome him home.
